cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me. Sunday, you owe me an equally embarrassing admission. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I trusted you to risk something too. What scares you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's equal. Now tell her over lunch. Mine had an audience; yours needs one too.

mechanism: A organizes a reciprocal admission before family lunch, allowing B to choose the content but insisting its public emotional risk match A earlier vulnerability.
confusable: Unlike ordinary encouragement to confide, A treats A admission as a debt; authority negotiates subject and companionship while maintaining repayment terms.
comparison: Competition for a mother affection differs from friends sharing academic failure in front of angry fathers.
seedUse: D118-a unsolicited mother disclosure and equal audience; S02-b adjusts conditions to keep the debtor participating.
